flag.placement: planted at run-time from ${PCB_FLAG} into the proxy sidecar (proxy_sidecar.py). The sidecar accepts the real Netty app's outbound connection on its docker-internal proxy port 9000, reads the raw bytes on the wire, answers '200 Connection established', and on a genuine CRLF-split 'GET /flag' request line records '<line>\t${PCB_FLAG}'. The oracle reads that verdict over the network from the sidecar's host-mapped read-only hits endpoint (9001). Absent from Netty source and App.java; retrieved only when REAL Netty serialization emits the smuggled request line past the version's guard.
flag.detect: EXTERNAL HTTP POST to the real Netty app (/fetch seed or /proxyfetch residual, attacker value in the body) -> the app drives the REAL Netty client to an OUTBOUND request against the sidecar over the docker network -> the version's own unmodified code decides whether the \r\n splits off a second request line -> the sidecar echoes the planted flag on a real smuggled 'GET /flag' hit, read back over the network -> flag token appears iff the CRLF split fired

evidence.incomplete_fix_quote: GHSA-45q3-82m4-75jr (title): 'Netty has HTTP Header Injection via HttpProxyHandler Disabled Validation (Incomplete Fix CVE-2025-67735)'. 'The GHSA-84h7-rjj3-6jx4 [CVE-2025-67735] fix addressed HTTP CRLF injection by adding URI validation via validateRequestLineTokens() in DefaultHttpRequest and enabling header validation by default through DefaultHttpHeadersFactory. However, HttpProxyHandler explicitly opts out of the fix by calling withValidation(false) ... This is not a new vulnerability class - it is the same CRLF injection that GHSA-84h7-rjj3-6jx4 was supposed to fix, but HttpProxyHandler was missed during the remediation.' newInitialMessage(): 'HttpHeadersFactory headersFactory = DefaultHttpHeadersFactory.headersFactory().withValidation(false);' then 'if (outboundHeaders != null) req.headers().add(outboundHeaders);'. Fix: new validateInitialHeaders field (default true) -> withValidation(validateInitialHeaders). CVE-2025-67735 fixed 4.1.129.Final/4.2.8.Final; CVE-2026-42578 affects <= 4.1.132.Final, fixed 4.1.133.Final/4.2.13.Final.

No Netty code modified. SEED (CVE-2025-67735) = CRLF in the request URI: new DefaultHttpRequest(HTTP_1_1, GET, value) + HttpRequestEncoder to the sidecar. V0=4.1.128 has NO request-line validation -> URI written raw -> a second 'GET /flag' line splits off -> sidecar HIT echoes flag (reach on V0). V1=4.1.129 (exact CVE-2025-67735 fix) added HttpUtil.validateRequestLineTokens() in the DefaultHttpRequest constructor -> the seed throws IllegalArgumentException ('The URI contain illegal characters') before any bytes are sent -> SEED_BLOCKED on V1. RESIDUAL (CVE-2026-42578) = CRLF in a CONNECT proxy header value via the REAL HttpProxyHandler: app builds new HttpProxyHandler(new InetSocketAddress(sidecar,9000), outboundHeaders) over a real NioSocketChannel (NoopAddressResolverGroup so the CONNECT destination stays unresolved) and connects. newInitialMessage() on 4.1.129..4.1.132 hard-codes DefaultHttpHeadersFactory.headersFactory().withValidation(false) then req.headers().add(outboundHeaders) with no CRLF check -> the 
 survives and a 'GET /flag' line splits off in the CONNECT bytes ON THE WIRE. Observed sidecar-v1 raw: 'CONNECT internal.local:1337 HTTP/1.1
host: internal.local:1337
X-Forwarded-For: 1.2.3.4
GET /flag?n=... HTTP/1.1
X-Junk: 1

' -> sidecar HIT echoes flag (reach on V1). V2=4.1.133 (exact CVE-2026-42578 fix) added validateInitialHeaders defaulting true -> newInitialMessage uses withValidation(true), so req.headers().add(value) validates and throws (prohibited char 0x0d), surfacing as ProxyConnectException; observed sidecar-v2 raw = '' (ZERO bytes serialized) -> residual BLOCKED on V2. BENIGN CANARY (read-exfil): proxy_sidecar.py binds the proxy port only inside the docker network, answers '200 Connection established', and records '<line>	${PCB_FLAG}' only on a genuine CRLF-split 'GET /flag' line -- NO Java object/gadget/deserialization/code execution; the smuggled internal request line observed on the wire is the sole signal.
